scenes.say: Ever wonder why a simple health check can take down your whole system? Let's see how to design one that keeps your app safe.

scenes.label: Fast
scenes.sub: Return a 200 in under 100 milliseconds, no login or redirects.
scenes.say: A good health check is fast. It returns a two hundred in under a hundred milliseconds, with no login or redirects.
Compare this. A good check uses a dedicated path, skips authentication, and answers quickly. Bad checks redirect to login, hit the database hard, or just test if a port is open.

scenes.title: Test your check
scenes.say: You can test your health check with curl using the resolve option to target the new virtual IP before going live. Look for a fast two hundred OK.

scenes.question: Should health checks hit the database?
scenes.right: No. If the database slows down, all nodes fail at once and get pulled. Keep liveness checks cheap and local.
scenes.say: Here's a classic trap. Should your health check hit the database? Not by default. If the database slows down, every node fails at once. Keep liveness checks cheap and local.
